stages.label: Lease / Scope Review
stages.summary: Confirm the job basics: client/GC, region (drives the UA local), jurisdiction, whether this is public works, and a scope summary.

requiredInfo.question: Which region is the job in (SF, East Bay, North Bay, Sacramento, San Jose)? This sets the UA local and wage scale.
Is this a public works job (> $1,000 of public funds)? If so, prevailing wage + weekly certified payroll + apprentice ratios apply.
Give me a one-line scope summary (what plumbing work is in this TI).

stages.label: Estimate & Takeoff (FastPipe)
stages.summary: Bring in the estimate — import a FastPipe Excel export or enter line items manually. Roll up labor hours, material, fixtures, rentals, tax.

requiredInfo.question: I need the estimate. Import your FastPipe Excel export (use /ingest <file>) or give me the line items to enter manually.
What is the total material cost (from the FastPipe export or manual entry)?

stages.label: Bid / Proposal
stages.summary: Compute the bid: loaded labor cost + material + tax + rentals + equipment, then apply burden / overhead / profit / contingency.

requiredInfo.question: I need to compute labor cost first — confirm the crew mix and wage rows so I can run compute_labor_cost.
What overhead % should I use on this bid?
What profit (markup) % should I use on this bid?

stages.label: Contract / Buyout
stages.summary: Award booked, contract value set, vendors and major material bought out.

requiredInfo.question: We need a computed bid total before buyout. Run the bid first.

stages.label: Submittals & RFIs
stages.summary: Track submittals (fixtures, valves, backflow, water heaters) and RFIs through approval.

stages.label: Schedule & Manpower
stages.summary: Build the install schedule (rough-in → inspection → top-out → inspection → trim/final) and load manpower against crew size.

requiredInfo.question: What is the planned start date so I can build the schedule?

stages.label: Procurement
stages.summary: Order long-lead and staged materials against the schedule need-by dates.

stages.label: Install & Inspections
stages.summary: Execute the install, log rough-in / top-out / final inspections and their results.

stages.label: Certified Payroll
stages.summary: On public works, produce weekly certified payroll (CPRs) and check apprentice-to-journeyman ratios.

stages.label: Change Orders
stages.summary: Price and track change orders; feed approved COs back into contract value.

stages.label: Closeout
stages.summary: As-builts, warranty, final inspection sign-off, retention release.
